description: Current CLI entry points and presentation states, audited and freshly captured from production revision f0fef4b01be998224dedc4c61c8167c720bd2013 on 2026-10-30. Rows include aliases and states, not distinct commands.
sourceDefinitions: rust/crates/zg-cli/src/lib.rs: command/action enums, argument normalization and plans
rust/crates/zg-cli/examples/interactive_presentation.rs: isolated credential and authorization prompt fixtures

evidenceDefinitions.real PTY: CLI executed in a pseudo-terminal. A picker capture may be cancelled before committing a selection. Only the stated command/scenario is execution evidence.
evidenceDefinitions.renderer fixture: Production renderer receives labelled sample input. PTY renderer fixtures exercise the real prompt in a pseudo-terminal through an isolated example program, not a completed zg operation. No corresponding indexing/search/configuration/authorization operation is implied.
evidenceDefinitions.protocol contract: Byte, stream or exit-status contract requiring tests; a screenshot is not authoritative. A referenced card may illustrate fixture bytes only.
evidenceDefinitions.not captured: Inventory item has no dedicated capture; shared implementation, parser coverage or help text is not counted as visual execution evidence.

naming.realCommandCards: cli- prefix; original PTY command capture ids are prefixed when published to avoid collisions with fixture ids
naming.interactiveCards: model-picker and install-picker retain ids from interactions.json
naming.fixtureCards: ids are emitted by the presentation example

scope.targetCoverage: Only opencode install/uninstall outcomes are executed in the command captures. Other target-specific and platform-specific file formats are covered by source/tests, not by these PTY captures.
scope.optionCoverage: Output-affecting branches are inventoried; this is not a Cartesian execution matrix for every filter, model, endpoint, device, target, transport or client mode.
